rule_text: For this review, the project-specific screening rule is: a commercial PV project with installed capacity greater than 250 kW and no more than 500 kW must connect at 10 kV. It must operate in self-consumption mode with export limited, have a forecast self-consumption ratio of at least 60%, and have an aggregate inverter AC rating no greater than its installed capacity. All conditions must be met.
answer_text: The proposal does not satisfy the screening rule. Its connection voltage and inverter rating meet the stated conditions, but the full-export mode and 0.45 self-consumption ratio do not.
